BiblicalUsage: Pâlag is to divide, to split. In the days of Peleg the earth was divided, and the psalmist prays, Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that division has two faces in this word: God divided the earth in judgment at Babel, and the psalmist asks Him to divide the tongues of violent men again.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
